title: Newly Established Waste Management Company Equity Stake For Sale in England, UK
tagline: We’re launching a start-up in the UK, focused on recycling end-of-life solar panels. - We have already registered the business and have a Certificate of Incorporation. - Once the business is commenced, we plan to process around 10,000 metric tonnes per annum, equivalent to about 430,000 solar panels! - We specialize in decommissioning solar panels and turning them back into raw materials like Aluminum, Copper, Glass, Plastics, and Silicone. - The need for recycling solar panels is growing in the UK, and it’s now a mandatory requirement! - Our founder has a solid background, having built a successful solar panel manufacturing facility in Texas, recognized as the EnergyTech company of the year. - We estimate the business can bring investors a healthy return of over 100% in just 5 years, with demand expected to raise tenfold in the next four years! - We’re seeking investment primarily to secure top-notch machinery to jumpstart our recycling operations.
